projects.title: Backpacker
projects.description:
Backpacker is an application that improves the backpacking experience for hikers in Yosemite. It provides safety alerts, trail, weather, and park information incorporating Google Maps API, National Park Services API, and weather API. This React-based web application has a stopwatch feature for calculating real-time speed of travel. And a PostgreSQL database along with Node JS server were used for the back-end.

▪️ Built multi-page app and implemented redirection of users upon sign up and login using Reach Router
▪️ Deployed full-stack features using React, Express, and PostgreSQL for users to login, sign up, and edit user information
▪️ Managed git workflow with continuous deployment in a team environment using agile methodologies

projects.title: BarBack
projects.description:
BarBack is a drink ordering tool for users to purchase drinks anywhere in the bar, and a bar management tool for business owners to view real-time statistics. New features such as adding tips, bar management statistics views, and dynamic menu rendering were added to a legacy code base using React, Reach Router, Recharts and more.

▪️ Refactored legacy codebase to resolve all asynchronous bugs for deployment
▪️ Built algorithm to parse and sort complex data aggregated from various MySQL sources
▪️ Designed modularized data visualizer with React and Recharts for bar statistics summary using real-time data
